kind: Kind Robots existing-resource reconciliation and addition submission
authority: User explicitly authorized aligning old LLM-generated records with later Zuzu worldbuilding on 2026-10-09.
legacy_canon_policy: Original Koala Assassin/Gallowsun Dream, Character, Reward and Scenario copy was filler produced by LLMs. It has ZERO automatic canon authority. Do not cite it as canonical source or preserve conflicting lore when editing those records. New canon comes from Book One / locked Cast Picks / Guardrails; Showdown-only extensions remain labeled separately.
write_policy: Query live scoped Character/Scenario/Reward rows first; match by owner and stable slug/name with provenance, never guess an ID.
For exact owned legacy matches, preserve IDs, user ownership, art history and unrelated links; patch only conflicting creative fields using model PATCH APIs.
Create only records with no defensible match. Do not duplicate similarly named records or overwrite unrelated users.
Resolve relationship IDs from actual records after creation; link cast/items using supported APIs. Do not assume historical Dream 183 is canonical.
Keep new or updated rows private pending authenticated live review. Respect mature/child access filters; do not publish externally.
This package is not an ArtJob request. Submit art through durable ArtJobs separately and attach only delivered reviewed images.
Source-backed character descriptions are adapted from Book One/locked cast; Showdown inventions remain explicitly noncanonical until adopted.

payload.name: Zuzu
payload.personality: Reserved and gravely polite; acts before speaking
payload.backstory: A small, grave koala ronin whose silence and careful acts of mercy sit uneasily with his work as a hired sword.
payload.presentation: short and stocky; slight paunch; rust-brown poncho with orange zigzag trim, dark tunic, orange sash, dark brown trousers, shallow wide-brimmed straw kasa; single sheathed katana diagonal across his back, hilt above right shoulder

payload.backstory: The older of two fox orphans, about ten. Fiercely protective of her toddler brother, wary of every adult and unwilling to abandon him.

payload.name: The Abbess
